title: The Ship
text: They have named the new flagship for me, Aurelle's Grace. I asked for a smaller ship and a plainer name, and was told an Empress does not ask. So I have stopped asking. The stern cabin is yours whenever she is on your coast.
note: In a chest in the sea cave, among the Gull Fleet's charts. They had kept it for the seal.
where: The Gull Isles, the sea cave
